item.title: Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers: 大肥鱼 / GPT娘 sticker knowledge kit for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), MCP and any chat bot · 大肥鱼表情包知识库
item.description: 大肥鱼哈基米表情包 · dsh-nekowhale-stickers. 给 DeepSeek Harness 的表情包知识库. 逐张标注的使用场景、画面描述、梗出处与互动方向 · 按需检索 · 本地出图. 中文 · English. 表情包作者：B站 可以叫我云大人/雾雪 · kiriyuki.com 制作 · 欢迎约原稿同款表情包！. 套组： 大肥鱼 · 大肥鱼和GPT娘. ✨ 特性. 📚 表情知识库. 逐张标注：场景标签、动作描述、关联梗，双人表情含 对象方向 ，对模型自身视觉依赖低。常驻上下文占用约 60 token。. 🔍 情绪检索. 按情绪和场景词打分，支持中文部分匹配；含随机去重。. 🎨 本地模板.… Why it matters: A ready-made annotated sticker library with search for chatbot and MCP projects; it has 75 GitHub stars.

item.title: Mainboard newbie Mi Material opens flat at S$1.80 in early trading
item.description: Semiconductor materials maker Mi Material opened flat at its S$1.80 IPO price on its Singapore Exchange mainboard debut.

item.title: Earnings call transcript: Adyen Q3 2026 revenue rises 23% as growth stays steady
BNP Paribas beats Q3 profit forecast, unveils US$1.4 billion share buyback
item.description: BNP Paribas's third-quarter net income rose 14% to 3.5 billion euros, beating analyst forecasts, and it announced a 1.3 billion euro share buyback.

item.title: SIA to buy sustainable aviation fuel made from waste gases at new Singapore plant
item.description: Singapore Airlines will buy up to 4,800 tonnes of sustainable aviation fuel from Aether Beacon over three years, starting 2028, made from waste carbon feedstocks.

item.title: Nvidia-backed firm launches US$3.1 bil GPU loan in market
item.description: Nvidia-backed Indonesian AI infrastructure platform Zankore is syndicating a US$3.1 billion loan to the broader market, people familiar with the matter said.

item.title: Third Serengeti Sweep Tops 1,400 Arrests as Investigations Mature
item.description: Interpol's Operation Serengeti III led to 1,462 arrests across 20 African countries and the US, recovering $105 million in stolen funds.

item.title: AI chips worth US$12.1 million seized at Malaysia airport, customs authority says
item.description: Malaysian customs seized about 49.5 million ringgit (US$12.11 million) of AI chips in 30 servers at Kuala Lumpur airport, linked to a smuggling probe.

item.title: TGM, Enterprise Singapore team up on startup expansion
item.description: TGM and Enterprise Singapore have teamed up on startup expansion; Enterprise Singapore's network spans more than 35 countries.

item.title: Motorola’s big US flagship comeback could come with an even bigger price tag
item.description: A Portuguese retailer listed Motorola's Signature 27 at €1,594.90 (about $1,773), hinting at a price increase; prices are unofficial.

item.title: Genspark Launches AI Video Production Studio That Takes Scripts to Subtitles in One Pipeline
item.description: Genspark has launched an AI video production studio that takes a script through to subtitles in one pipeline. Why it matters: Shows AI tools expanding into end-to-end video production.

item.title: Bumble Founder Whitney Wolfe Herd Explains Decision to Take Company Private
item.description: Bumble CEO Whitney Wolfe Herd said the $1.3 billion sale to Ithaca Holdings, taking the dating app private, was important for its mission.

item.title: Meta’s Muse lands in Singapore with a guest list Amazon never got
item.description: Meta's Muse personal AI agent has arrived in Singapore, after Amazon complained that it entered Amazon.com unannounced and without permission in the US.

item.title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics Q3 profit soars 165% on AI demand
item.description: Samsung Electro-Mechanics' third-quarter profit rose 165% on AI demand, while optical solutions revenue rose 3% year on year to 941.3 billion won.

item.title: Bitcoin treasury Datavault AI plunges 50% after firm says it can’t access its BTC
item.description: Datavault AI shares plunged nearly 50% after it disclosed it could not withdraw bitcoin held on Biconomy since June and would restate its financial results.

item.title: Jio shares surge 21% in market debut after blockbuster India IPO
item.description: Jio Platforms shares rose 21% in their market debut after a $3.2 billion IPO drew bids for 22.19 times the shares on sale.

item.title: The climate tech startups still growing despite the funding slowdown
item.description: Has the world given up on cutting carbon emissions? For some in the climate tech industry, it certainly feels that way.

item.title: Exclusive: Lovable offers employees $80m cash-out at $13.3bn valuation
item.description: Swedish startup Lovable is letting employees cash out $80 million in shares at the $13.3 billion valuation set in its August Series C.

item.title: anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh: Chinese-language AI pose reference gallery · 1,439 sets / 2,878 images / fully localized · zero-dependency static gallery
item.description: A fully localized Chinese-language AI pose reference gallery with 1,439 sets and 2,878 images, delivered as a zero-dependency static gallery. Why it matters: A large AI-image resource packaged as a dependency-free static gallery, notable for its size and localization.

item.title: Motionsites-AI/claude-skill: Free Claude skill: make Claude build award-level, cinematic landing pages. By MotionSites
item.description: A free Claude skill that makes Claude build cinematic landing pages using liked example prompts and media, then screenshot and fix its own output.

item.title: stormydayy/halo-overlay: Lightweight opensource AI overlay for live conversations. Hears, sees, suggests
item.description: Halo is an open-source AI overlay that listens to a conversation, sees your screen, and offers short in-the-moment suggestions.

item.title: blakeandersonw/ai-app-playbook: How to build useful, profitable apps in 2026. Clone it and point your coding agent at AGENTS.md
item.description: A playbook for building useful, profitable apps in 2026, covering problem selection, a recommended stack, costs, and reaching a first profitable month.

item.title: emanuele-em/kanzo: Self-hosted kanban for humans and agents. One 4 MB binary, starts in 2 ms, zero setup
item.description: Kanzo is a self-hosted kanban board and MCP server in one 4 MB program, letting humans and coding agents work on the same tasks.

item.title: emrahaydemir960-ai/daimon-data-agent: Open Source Data Science Agent for Discord and Slack
item.description: daimon is an open-source data science agent for Discord, Slack, and Microsoft Teams that answers analysis questions in-thread with code, Bayesian models, charts and notebooks.

item.title: Sources: CXMT plans to start HBM3E production despite yields of just 20% to 30%; its HBM3E performance is closer to that of SK Hynix's previous-gen HBM3 chips
item.description: Sources say China's CXMT plans to start HBM3E production despite yields of just 20% to 30%, with performance closer to SK Hynix's previous-generation HBM3.

item.title: Bitcoin nears $81,000 ahead of Fed decision as ZEC jumps 8%
item.description: Bitcoin rose nearly 2% to just under $81,000 ahead of the Federal Reserve's rate decision, as other major cryptocurrencies also advanced.

item.title: Anthropic begins its own 'drug discovery' activities: acquires a bio company with one employee, advancing research on treatments for intractable pediatric diseases
item.description: Anthropic has begun drug discovery work by acquiring a bio company with one employee, advancing research on treatments for intractable pediatric diseases.

item.title: Ant Group Open-Sources Ling-3.1-flash-1019 and Its Base Model, Aiming at Personal Agents
item.description: Ant Group's Ling team open-sourced Ling-3.1-flash-1019, a post-trained model scoring 44 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, plus the Ling-3.1-flash-base model under MIT license.

item.title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams
item.description: The paper proposes Skill Dreaming, a framework that builds and refines repository-specific LLM agent skills by learning from a repo's pull request history.

item.title: When Retrieval Is Not Enough: Obsolete Facts in Agent Memory
item.description: Finds that retrieving the correct fact is not enough for memory agents, since an obsolete competing statement can hurt accuracy more than unrelated evidence.

item.title: OmniBrain-0: A Unified Agentic Model for Embodied Intelligence
item.description: Proposes OmniBrain-0, a lightweight unified agent that coordinates robot manipulation and navigation through one shared decision model trained by distillation from teacher models.

item.title: Two Tiong Bahru HDB blocks to proceed with HIP upgrading after successful re-poll
item.description: Two Tiong Bahru HDB blocks, 34 and 35, will get HIP upgrading after re-polls on Oct 25 gave them 75% and 87% approval.

item.title: Labubu-maker Pop Mart's shares extend declines as third-quarter sales plunge
item.description: Pop Mart's third-quarter revenue fell 45% to 50% year on year, with overseas sales hit hardest, and its shares are down over 30% this year.

item.title: Bithumb discloses data leak after internal system breach: Report
item.description: Bithumb is investigating whether member data leaked after hackers breached its internal employee mobile system.

item.title: Oil prices rise after attack on Saudi Arabian refinery reignites supply concerns
item.description: Oil prices rose after Yemen's Houthis said they hit Saudi Arabia's biggest refinery with a missile; Saudi authorities had not immediately confirmed it.

item.title: OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips, The Information reports
item.description: OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips, The Information reported, citing a person familiar with the matter. The deal would deepen ties between two companies that compete in AI products and search. Why it matters: Shows OpenAI and Google deepening ties as AI computing demand surges and Google's chips gain traction against Nvidia.

item.title: Oil holds decline as traders track result of Israeli election
item.description: Oil held a two-day drop as traders tracked a tight Israeli election that will help to shape the course of the US war with Iran.

item.title: Does ethnicity affect the type of breast cancer you develop and how easily it's detected?
item.description: Asian women tend to have denser breasts, which can make cancer harder to detect; ethnicity alone doesn't determine how the disease behaves.

item.title: Sea’s financial services arm Monee should consider an IPO on SGX
item.description: Sea is weighing a listing for its financial services arm Monee, and the Singapore Exchange is one venue it could consider.

item.title: OLED Touchscreen MacBook Pro Could Start at $2,899
item.description: Bloomberg reports Apple has discussed pricing the 14-inch OLED MacBook Pro with M5 Pro at $2,899, $400 above the current model's $2,499.

item.title: Guidewire buys Hyperexponential for $1.7B in cash
item.description: Insurance tech firm Guidewire buys agentic underwriting company Hyperexponential for $1.7 billion in cash, to bring AI agents alongside humans in underwriting, analysis and pricing.

item.title: An Anthropic hiring manager says he stopped giving coding interviews because Claude is better at them and tells junior engineers that "hunger beats tenure"
item.description: An Anthropic hiring manager says he dropped coding interviews because Claude is better at them, and tells junior engineers that 'hunger beats tenure.'

item.title: UNM Health ransomware attack disrupts patient care, surgeries
item.description: UNM Health disclosed a cyberattack that caused system outages, temporarily limited new admissions, diverted ambulances, and suspended outpatient surgeries and appointments.

item.title: Air quality continues to improve across Singapore
item.description: Air quality in Singapore continues to improve, with PM2.5 in the normal range and 24-hour PSI 'good to moderate'.

item.title: VanEck launches diversified ETF combining stocks, bonds and Bitcoin exposure
item.description: VanEck launched an actively managed ETF combining stocks, bonds and real assets, with a target 2% Bitcoin allocation via a spot Bitcoin ETP.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Zero 3W and Pi 4 Model A spotted in device trees
item.description: Kernel device tree files hint at new Raspberry Pi Zero 3 W and Pi 4 Model A boards; no official announcement yet.

item.title: Nefilim, Hive ransomware operator given five-year-plus sentence after guilty plea
item.description: Ukrainian Artem Stryzhak, 36, who worked with the Nefilim and Hive ransomware groups, was sentenced to 70 months in prison after pleading guilty.

item.title: Vital Skills: Upskilling Genie Code with Healthcare and Life Sciences skills
item.description: Databricks Vital Skills adds packaged healthcare and life sciences playbooks, built on the open Agent Skills standard, to Genie Code.
